title: 摩根士丹利威尔逊：三大事件落地或成市场配置窗口
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Mike Wilson of Morgan Stanley writing several clearing events play out over the next few weeks.
segments.zh: 摩根士丹利的Mike Wilson写道，未来几周将有几项出清事件上演。

segments.en: This should provide attractive buying opportunities as the market looks ahead to another leg higher in earnings growth. Mike joins us now for more. Mike, good morning.
segments.zh: 这应会提供有吸引力的买入机会，因市场预期盈利增长将再上一个台阶。Mike现在加入我们带来更多分析。Mike，早上好。

segments.en: Good morning. Those clearing events were the feature of your note to start this week. You identified three of them. Can you share them with us this morning?
segments.zh: 早上好。这些出清事件是你本周初报告的重点。你指出了三个。今天能和我们分享一下吗？

segments.en: Yeah. Well, first of all, maybe we get 12% bond in Brazil too. Don't forget about that.
segments.zh: 好的。首先，也许我们在巴西还能获得12%的债券收益。别忘了这一点。

segments.en: So, what I would say is, you know, the markets have a way, and part of the reason why the people are kind of looking at pastles. There's so much going on, they can't focus.
segments.zh: 所以，我想说的是，市场有其运行方式，人们关注过去的部分原因是事情太多，无法集中注意力。

segments.en: So, the markets kind of grab onto what they know, which is earnings are still pretty good.
segments.zh: 因此，市场会抓住它们所知道的，即盈利仍然相当不错。

segments.en: Rates have actually come down, it's been more steady, so that's not a bad environment to be looking to add risk. Now, the three things that we were most focused on now,
segments.zh: 利率实际上已经下降，更加稳定，所以这不是一个糟糕的环境来考虑增加风险。现在，我们最关注的三个事情，

segments.en: and in no particular order, the obvious ones are the midterm elections, which is always a clearing event. I mean, historically, it's always a good time to be adding risk into that event. Now,
segments.zh: 不分先后，明显的是中期选举，这总是一个出清事件。我的意思是，历史上，这总是增加风险的好时机。现在，

segments.en: sometimes it could linger another month or so, but over the next six to 12 months, 100% certainty going back to 1952, you make positive returns, and usually double digits.
segments.zh: 有时可能会再持续一个月左右，但在未来6到12个月，100%确定，回溯到1952年，你会获得正回报，通常还是两位数。

segments.en: So, that's just something to keep in the back of your mind, as things get wobbly, keep that in the back of your mind as you should be stepping in and adding risk.
segments.zh: 所以，这只是你要记在心里的事情，当事情变得波动时，记住这一点，你应该介入并增加风险。

segments.en: Number two, I think, is around this idea around AI catbacks and the scarcity of capital.
segments.zh: 第二点，我认为是关于AI资本回流和资金稀缺性的观点。

segments.en: Okay, that one's pretty well understood too, and I think these companies are dealing with it properly, right? So, they're doing the back and forth between equity issuance and debt issuance.
segments.zh: 这一点也相当好理解，我认为这些公司处理得当，对吧？他们在股权发行和债务发行之间来回操作。
